name: W2LIST_KM3NEUT_PS
comment: Constant factor in the weight (global generation weight)

name: W2LIST_KM3NEUT_EG
comment: E gamma

name: W2LIST_KM3NEUT_XSEC_MEAN
comment: Average interaction cross-section per nucleon along the neutrino path throuh the Earth (in units of m2)

name: W2LIST_KM3NEUT_COLUMN_DEPTH
comment: Line integrated column density through the Earth for the neutrino direction

name: W2LIST_KM3NEUT_P_EARTH
comment: Transmission probability in the Earth (XSEC_MEAN and COLUMN_DEPTH used to compute PEarth)

name: W2LIST_KM3NEUT_WATER_INT_LEN
comment: Interaction length in pure water in m

name: W2LIST_KM3NEUT_P_SCALE
comment: Interaction probability scale

name: W2LIST_KM3NEUT_BX
comment: Bjorken x

name: W2LIST_KM3NEUT_BY
comment: Bjorken y

name: W2LIST_KM3NEUT_ICHAN
comment: Interaction channel converted to genie mode

name: W2LIST_KM3NEUT_CC
comment: Charged current interaction flag

name: W2LIST_KM3NEUT_WATERXSEC
comment: inclusive xsec in water

name: W2LIST_KM3NEUT_XSEC
comment: total cross section of the interaction

name: W2LIST_KM3NEUT_DXSEC
comment: differential cross section of the interaction (dsigma/dE)

name: W2LIST_KM3NEUT_TARGETA
comment: number of nucleons in the target

name: W2LIST_KM3NEUT_TARGETZ
comment: number of protons in the target

name: W2LIST_KM3NEUT_VERINCAN
comment: flag indicating the vertex is in the can

name: W2LIST_KM3NEUT_LEPINCAN
comment: flag indicating a lepton reached the can

name: W2LIST_KM3NEUT_MODE
comment: Neut mode

name: W2LIST_KM3NEUT_W
comment: Invariant Hadronic Mass calculated from event
